Book a Table Italian Traditions Café Meridiano brings authentic Italian hospitality to the heart of Greenwich. Inspired by family recipes and the lively cafés of Italy, we pair time-honoured culinary traditions with the refined charm of London. Every espresso is pulled with care, every brioche baked fresh each morning, and every visit feels like coming home. From our golden schiacciata to our handcrafted aperitivo cocktails, we invite you to slow down, gather and savour the true spirit of Italy.
